params.name: steps

default.title: Your seller's desk
default.say: Keys for sale is where you offer credit on your own AI keys. Until one key is on sale, nobody on the portal sees a Buy a key menu.

default.title: Sell a key
default.say: Press Sell a key, choose which of your keys, name the offer and set what to add on top of each run. Tick On sale to put it on the shelf.

default.title: What you are selling
default.say: Every offer is listed with its terms. Edit changes it at any time; Remove takes it off the shelf, and credit already bought keeps working.

default.title: Answer requests
default.say: Requests waiting shows who asked, for which offer and how much. Approve hands over prepaid credit and raises a bill; Turn down tells them no, with a reason if you wish.

default.title: A clear record
default.say: Already answered keeps every decision with its amount, state and the credit still left. No money moves through the portal; the record is there for your own settling.

params.label: The steps in order: title, say (the narration), target (where the spotlight goes; alternatives split by |, the first on screen wins), art (the picture: hero/flow/roads/meter/stack/check), place (below/above/right/left/center, optional), open (optional: what the guide presses first when the part is not on screen - open the first item, go back Home; alternatives split by |)
